name: Rasan Information Technology Company
note: Saudi fintech/insurtech group (Tameeni, Treza), listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 8313) since May 2024. Its 2024 IPO prospectus names the 5%+ shareholders: four individuals (Theib AlMutairi, Muheideb AlMuheideb, Samer Raslan, Mohammed AlMuheideb) and two Osool & Bakheet custodian vehicles — Impact Funds for Financial Technology Company (13.06% post-offering) and Assets Custody Development Impact Company (4.49% post-offering) — which hold for Impact46-managed venture funds (Venture Capital InsurTech Fund and Impact Growth Fund); the funds' investors are not disclosed.
